tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is warm birch-paper, dark is night forest.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the alert drawer.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Inputs, wells, the map frame.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). 3:1 or better on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps. 4.5:1+ on every paper token.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Brand colour. Primary buttons, links, the logo, selected states. As text, on any paper token.

tokens.name: on-pine
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pine fill.

tokens.name: pine-deep
tokens.usage: Large brand fields: deck covers, hero bands, the app icon ground. Pair with on-pine-deep.

tokens.name: on-pine-deep
tokens.usage: Text on pine-deep in both themes.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Sprout's accent: native plants, growth, progress fills. 3:1 on paper for shapes and icons; never body text.

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind native / fire-wise results. Text on it is pine or ink.

tokens.name: birch
tokens.usage: Warm relief tint for illustrations, empty states and print backgrounds.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Fire, in the brand voice: invasive / fire-prone verdicts, marketing accents. Never for alert levels. As text, on paper tokens.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on an ember fill.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind invasive / fire-prone results. Text on it is ember or ink.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Air and data: smoke readings, map overlays, info notes, links inside data views. As text, on paper tokens.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind info notes and sensor tiles. Text on it is sky or ink.

tokens.name: alert-clear
tokens.usage: Level 0, all clear. Fill; text on it is on-alert-clear.

tokens.name: on-alert-clear
tokens.usage: Text on alert-clear.

tokens.name: alert-advisory
tokens.usage: Level 1, advisory (smoke nearby): Sylvia's own, always labelled Unverified. Lightest of the scale. Text on it is on-alert-amber.

tokens.name: alert-warning
tokens.usage: Level 2, warning (get ready to leave): Sylvia's own, always labelled Unverified. Middle lightness. Text on it is on-alert-amber.

tokens.name: on-alert-amber
tokens.usage: Text on alert-advisory and alert-warning (never white).

tokens.name: alert-evacuate
tokens.usage: Level 3, official order: only when relaying a government evacuation order, naming the agency. Darkest of the scale. Text on it is on-alert-evacuate.

tokens.name: on-alert-evacuate
tokens.usage: Text on alert-evacuate.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (sky). Always drawn outside a 2px paper gap (see focus-ring), so it reads on every paper even around pine buttons.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Instrument Serif: the voice of the brand. Headlines, the wordmark, deck titles. Never for alerts, buttons or anything under 24px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Deck covers, landing hero. One per page.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Warnings arrive last for the people who need the most time.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Plant names in Sprout results, pull quotes.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, drawn by the Braille Institute for low-vision readers. Body starts at 17px because our first users include older adults.

styles.name: alert-title
styles.usage: Alert banners and push titles only. Two to four words.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Japanese barberry is invasive in Ontario. It spreads into woodlands and crowds out native shrubs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Updated 2 minutes ago from 6 nearby sensors.
styles.usage: Supporting text. Never for instructions people must follow.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for readings, IDs and eyebrows, so numbers line up and 0/O, 1/l never get confused.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: The big number on a sensor tile.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above titles and alert levels.

spacing.note: 4px base. Touch targets never below size-target.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags, between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on larger screens, alert banner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Slide margins, page sections on web.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding, deck title margins.

radius.note: Soft like a leaf, never bubbly.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, sensor tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, alert banners, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, the node status dot.

shadow.note: Quiet. Borders do most of the work; shadow only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Alert banners pinned over the map, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px paper gap, then 3px of sky. Use as box-shadow so it follows the radius.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size (icons are drawn on a 24 grid, 1.75 stroke).

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside tags and dense rows.

tokens.name: size-logo-min
tokens.usage: Smallest the Signal Leaf mark may be shown on screen; below this use the favicon cut.
